data.name: Jasvika
data.gender_notes: Jasvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jas means pure, sincere and Vika means auspicious or victorious. This name represents the pure and sincere soul who is victorious in her endeavors. The name Jasvika carries the meaning “Pure, Sincere, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jasvika usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, sincere, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jasvika is a powerful name that is believed to bring success and victory in all aspects of life. It is a name that resonates with the energy of the divine mother, who is the giver of life and the nurturer of all beings.
data.etymology: Jasvika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Sincere, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jasvika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
